spans.s: शोभन (I) a. (f. ना or नी) 1. Beautiful, handsome, splendid, shining; 2. richly ornamented; 3. virtuous, moral; 4. auspicious.
शोभन (II) m. 1. A planet; 2. a burnt offering for the achievement of good; 3. an epithet of Śiva.
शोभन (III) n. 1. Brilliance, beauty; 2. a lotus.
शोभन (I) a. (f. ना or नी) 1. Beautiful, handsome, splendid, shining; 2. richly ornamented; 3. virtuous, moral; 4. auspicious.
शोभना f. 1. A virtuous or beautiful woman, K.S.iv.44; 2. turmeric; 3. a kind of pigment called गोरोचना.
शोभन (I) a. (f. ना or नी) 1. Beautiful, handsome, splendid, shining; 2. richly ornamented; 3. virtuous, moral; 4. auspicious.

शोभा f. 1. Light, lustre, radiance; 2. beauty, grace, loveliness, शोभां शुभ्रत्रिनयववृषोत्खातपंकोपमेयाम् Megh.i.52, 59, R.xvi.59; 3. grandeur, अद्रिशोभाप्रहितेक्षणेन R.ii.27; 4. turmeric; 5. a kind of pigment called गोरोचना.
शोभा-अंजन m. name of a tree.
शोभित a. (f. ता) Beautiful, adorned, decorated.
